title: Add operator identity and authorization model for Discord users, Telegram users, admin profiles, project scopes, and action classes
summary: Map platform identities into Hermes operator policy so remote requests can be accepted, blocked, scoped, and audited.
acceptanceCriteria: Gateway identity includes source, user, channel/chat, display name, and platform message id.
Authorization checks gateway, user, project, emergency stop, and live action policy.
Action classes distinguish read-only, research, build, commit, push, deploy, destructive, approval, and unknown requests.
reviewNotes: Implemented RemoteGatewayIdentity, action classification, normalized remote requests, and authorization tests.
